text.title: Rails 7+ Backend Procedure
text.summary: 7-step procedure to apply the Rails 7+ methodology end-to-end — five steps on the service / job architecture, then two that bring the app back onto the framework's conventions.

step.name: lock-serviceresult
step.action: Create `app/services/service_result.rb` with `success?`, `failure?`, `value`, `errors`. Add CI grep that fails on additional `class ServiceResult` definitions.
step.decision-gate: If a second ServiceResult appears, BLOCK per `one-serviceresult-class` rule.

step.name: extract-service-per-verb
step.action: For each verb create `<Domain>::<Verb>Service` with `initialize(params:, current_user:)` and `call` returning `ServiceResult`. Controllers do Strong Params then `Service.new(params: permitted, current_user: current_user).call`.
step.decision-gate: If service touches `params` or HTTP globals, BLOCK per `strong-params-not-into-service` rule.

step.name: transaction-and-after-commit
step.action: Wrap writes in `ActiveRecord::Base.transaction do ... end`. Move mailers / webhooks / search indexing to `after_create_commit` callbacks or chained Sidekiq jobs after the transaction returns.
step.decision-gate: If `deliver_later` lands inside the transaction, BLOCK per `after-commit-for-side-effects` rule.

step.name: sidekiq-with-ids-and-retry
step.action: Declare `perform(record_id, ...)` with primitives. Add `sidekiq_options retry: 5, dead: true` + `sidekiq_retry_in` per exception. Inside `perform` reload the record from DB.
step.decision-gate: If AR object passed as arg, BLOCK per `sidekiq-jobs-take-ids` rule.

step.name: rspec-per-branch
step.action: Add request specs (`spec/requests/...`) for controller paths and service specs (`spec/services/...`) for branches. Use FactoryBot `build_stubbed` where persistence isn't needed.

step.name: restore-restful-routing
step.action: Count the ad-hoc routes, then regroup them by resource into `resources` blocks, using `member` / `collection` for the non-CRUD verbs and `shallow: true` for nested resources. Give each controller a private `<resource>_params` method built from `params.require(...).permit(...)` and have every action use it.
step.output: Resourceful routes with named helpers + mass-assignment-safe controllers
step.decision-gate: If an endpoint is still declared ad hoc without being genuinely non-CRUD, BLOCK per `restful-resources`; if a controller mass-assigns unpermitted params, BLOCK per `strong-params-not-into-service`.

step.name: callbacks-concerns-and-credentials
step.input: Models with callbacks, duplicated model methods, ENV-held secrets
step.action: For each `after_create :send_email` / `after_save :enqueue_job`, move the effect into the service that owns the verb and delete the callback, keeping only invariants. Extract any method duplicated across ≥2 models into `app/models/concerns/`. Move each production secret into `config/credentials.yml.enc` via `rails credentials:edit`, switch call sites to `Rails.application.credentials`, and remove the ENV var from the deploy script.
step.output: Invariant-only callbacks, shared logic in concerns, encrypted credentials
step.decision-gate: If a callback still triggers an external effect, BLOCK per `callback-only-for-invariants`; if a secret is still read from ENV in production, BLOCK per `credentials-not-env`.
